HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

generation.free_design:
Place: A quiet present-day riverside swimming pier with bright blue safety floats and clean stone steps.
Activity: She checks the attachment of a safety float before a supervised swim, then unclips and folds her detachable swim shoulder cape onto the bench to keep it dry.
Pose: Standing three-quarter front beside the bench, her hands hold the two corners of the little cape separately, with both arms clear of her torso.
Framing: Vertical mid-thigh portrait at standing eye level in bright afternoon light, with the river and float visible.
Outfit: An opaque ink-blue two-piece sport swimsuit with an asymmetric mint stripe, a high-waisted bottom with double-loop side ties, and a detachable mint swim shoulder cape set on the bench.
